### Fixed
- **The models Gateway's data plane is an internet-facing load balancer on AWS** (giantswarm/agent-platform#690). On a workload cluster with the AWS Load Balancer Controller the data plane's Service carried no scheme, so it became an internal NLB and external-dns published the models host with private addresses. `modelServing.modelsGateway.service.annotations` renders on the Gateway's `infrastructure.annotations`, which the Service inherits, with and without external-dns; the default is `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: internet-facing`, and an explicit value replaces it (`internal` for a private models host). Other providers ignore the annotation. `make verify-serving-slice` holds the default and the override.
